chunks: Abū Baṣīr asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who leaves the ghusl of the day of al-Jumuʿah forgetfully or deliberately, and he said:
If he was forgetful, then his salat (prayer) is complete. But if he was deliberate, then let him seek forgiveness from Allah and not do it again.

key_terms.فَلْيَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ: let him seek forgiveness from Allah
key_terms.وَلَا يَعُدْ: and let him not repeat it

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone leaves the Friday ghusl forgetfully or intentionally?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding leaving the ghusl of Friday. If it was omitted out of forgetfulness, the salat (prayer) remains valid; if omitted deliberately, the person must seek forgiveness from Allah and not repeat that neglect.
